title.zh: 卷三十 本紀第三十: 泰定帝二
title.raw: 卷三十 本紀第三十: 泰定帝二 Volume 30 Annals 30: Emperor Taiding 2

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丙午朔，征東行省左丞相、高麗國王王章，遣使奉方物，賀正旦。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, on bingwu new moon, Eastern Campaign branch secretariat left grand councillor and King of Koryo Wang Zhang dispatched envoys presenting tribute goods to congratulate the New Year's day.
translations.idiomatic: Third year, spring, first month, on bingwu new moon, Eastern Campaign branch secretariat left grand councillor and King of Koryo Wang Zhang dispatched envoys presenting tribute goods to congratulate the New Year's day.

sentences.zh: 播州宣慰使楊燕裏不花招諭蠻酋黎平慶等來降。

translations.literal: Bozhou pacification commissioner Yang Yanlibuhua summoned and instructed the barbarian chieftain Li Pingqing and others to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Bozhou pacification commissioner Yang Yanlibuhua summoned and instructed the barbarian chieftain Li Pingqing and others to submit.

sentences.zh: 戊申，元江路總管普雙叛，命雲南行省招捕之。

translations.literal: On wushen day Yuanjiang Route director-general Pushuang rebelled; the Yunnan Branch Secretariat was ordered to summon and capture him.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Yuanjiang Route director-general Pushuang rebelled; the Yunnan Branch Secretariat was ordered to summon and capture him.

sentences.zh: 諸王薛徹禿、晃火帖木兒來朝，賜金、銀、鈔、幣有差。

translations.literal: Princes Xiechetu and Huanghuo Temür came to court; gold, silver, notes, and silks were granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Princes Xiechetu and Huanghuo Temür came to court; gold, silver, notes, and silks were granted in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 壬子，封諸王寬徹不花為威順王，鎮湖廣；

translations.literal: On renzi day Prince Kanchibuhua was enfeoffed Prince of Weishun and stationed at Huguang;
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Prince Kanchibuhua was enfeoffed Prince of Weishun and stationed at Huguang;

sentences.zh: 買奴為宣靖王，鎮益都；

translations.literal: Mainu was enfeoffed Prince of Xuanjing and stationed at Yidu;
translations.idiomatic: Mainu was enfeoffed Prince of Xuanjing and stationed at Yidu;

sentences.zh: 各賜鈔三千錠。

translations.literal: each was granted three thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: each was granted 3,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 以山東、湖廣官田賜民耕墾，人三頃，仍給牛具。

translations.literal: Official fields in Shandong and Huguang were granted to the people for cultivation and reclamation — three qing per person — and cattle and implements were still provided.
translations.idiomatic: Official fields in Shandong and Huguang were granted to the people for cultivation and reclamation — 3 qing per person — and cattle and implements were still provided.

sentences.zh: 諸王不賽因遣使獻西馬。

translations.literal: Prince Busiyin dispatched envoys presenting western horses.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Busiyin dispatched envoys presenting western horses.

sentences.zh: 征前翰林學士吳澄，不起。

translations.literal: Former Hanlin academician Wu Cheng was summoned but did not accept appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Former Hanlin academician Wu Cheng was summoned but did not accept appointment.

sentences.zh: 置都水庸田司於松江，掌江南河渠水利。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Waterways and State Farms was established at Songjiang to manage Jiangnan river channels and waterworks.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Waterways and State Farms was established at Songjiang to manage Jiangnan river channels and waterworks.

sentences.zh: 己未，賜武平王帖古思不花部軍民鈔，人十五錠。

translations.literal: On jiwei day notes were granted to the troops and people under Prince of Wuping Tagusibuhua — fifteen ingots per person.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day notes were granted to the troops and people under Prince of Wuping Tagusibuhua — 15 ingots per person.

sentences.zh: 以湘寧王八剌失裏鎮兀魯思部。

translations.literal: Prince of Xiangning Bala Temür was stationed to guard the Ulus tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Xiangning Bala Temür was stationed to guard the Ulus tribe.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，太白犯外屏。

translations.literal: On xinyou day Venus encroached upon Outer Screen.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Venus encroached upon Outer Screen.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，封朵列捏為國公，以知樞密院事撒忒迷失為嶺北行中書省平章政事。

translations.literal: On guihai day Duolienie was enfeoffed Duke of State; privy council director Satemishi was made Lingbei branch secretariat grand councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Duolienie was enfeoffed Duke of State; privy council director Satemishi was made Lingbei branch secretariat grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，緬國亂，其主答裏也伯遣使來乞師，獻馴象方物。

translations.literal: On wuchen day Burma fell into disorder; its ruler Daliyabo dispatched envoys requesting troops and presented trained elephants and tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Burma fell into disorder; its ruler Daliyabo dispatched envoys requesting troops and presented trained elephants and tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 安南國阮叩寇思明路，命湖廣行省督兵備之。

translations.literal: Ruan Kou of Annam raided Siming Route; the Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to supervise troops in preparing defenses.
translations.idiomatic: Ruan Kou of Annam raided Siming Route; the Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to supervise troops in preparing defenses.

sentences.zh: 大都路屬縣饑，賑糧六萬石。

translations.literal: Subordinate counties of Dadu Route suffered famine; sixty thousand shi of grain were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate counties of Dadu Route suffered famine; 60,000 shi of grain were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 恩州水，以糧賑之。

translations.literal: Enzhou suffered flooding; grain was issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Enzhou suffered flooding; grain was issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，購能首告謀逆厭魅者給賞，立賞格，諭中外。

translations.literal: Second month, on dingchou day rewards were offered for anyone who could first report treasonous plots or sorcerous bewitchment; a reward scale was established and proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, on dingchou day rewards were offered for anyone who could first report treasonous plots or sorcerous bewitchment; a reward scale was established and proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，賑魯王阿兒加失裏部甕吉剌貧民鈔六萬錠，命諸王魯賓為大宗正。

translations.literal: On gengchen day sixty thousand ingots of notes were granted to relieve impoverished Onggirad commoners under Prince of Lu Argasibuhua; Prince Lubin was made grand master of the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day 60,000 ingots of notes were granted to relieve impoverished Onggirad commoners under Prince of Lu Argasibuhua; Prince Lubin was made grand master of the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 壬午，廣西全茗州土官許文傑率諸徭以叛，寇茗盈州，殺知州事李德卿等，命湖廣行省督兵捕之。

translations.literal: On renwu day Xu Wenjie, native official of Quanming Prefecture in Guangxi, led various Yao in rebellion, raided Mingying Prefecture, and killed acting prefect Li Deqing and others; the Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to supervise troops in capturing them.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Xu Wenjie, native official of Quanming Prefecture in Guangxi, led various Yao in rebellion, raided Mingying Prefecture, and killed acting prefect Li Deqing and others; the Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to supervise troops in capturing them.

sentences.zh: 以乃馬臺知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Namatai was made privy council director.
translations.idiomatic: Namatai was made privy council director.

sentences.zh: 甲申，祭太祖、太宗、睿宗御容於翰林國史院。

translations.literal: On jiashen day the imperial portraits of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong were sacrificed to at the Hanlin National History Academy.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the imperial portraits of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong were sacrificed to at the Hanlin National History Academy.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，中書請罷征徭，敕斡耳朵罕等班師，其鎮戍者如故。

translations.literal: On dinghai day the Central Secretariat requested cessation of the Yao campaign; an edict directed Prince Ordoe'erhan and others to withdraw their armies, while garrison troops were to remain as before.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Central Secretariat requested cessation of the Yao campaign; an edict directed Prince Ordoe'erhan and others to withdraw their armies, while garrison troops were to remain as before.

sentences.zh: 己丑，禁汴梁路釀酒。

translations.literal: On jichou day wine-brewing was forbidden in Bianliang Route.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day wine-brewing was forbidden in Bianliang Route.

sentences.zh: 甲午，葺真定玉華宮。

translations.literal: On jiawu day Zhending's Yuhua Palace was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Zhending's Yuhua Palace was repaired.

sentences.zh: 乙未，修佛事厭雷於崇天門。

translations.literal: On yiwei day Buddhist rites to avert thunder were performed at Chongtian Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Buddhist rites to avert thunder were performed at Chongtian Gate.

sentences.zh: 丙申，建顯宗神御殿於盧師寺，賜額曰大天源延聖寺。

translations.literal: On bingshen day a spirit hall for Emperor Xianzong was built at Lushi Temple; the granted name was Great Heavenly Source Extended Sage Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day a spirit hall for Emperor Xianzong was built at Lushi Temple; the granted name was Great Heavenly Source Extended Sage Temple.

sentences.zh: 敕以金書西番字《藏經》。

translations.literal: An edict directed that the 《Scripture Treasury》 be written in gold in Western script.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed that the 《Scripture Treasury》 be written in gold in Western script.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，建殊祥寺於五臺山，賜田三百頃。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day Shuxiang Temple was built on Mount Wutai; three hundred qing of fields were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Shuxiang Temple was built on Mount Wutai; 300 qing of fields were granted.

sentences.zh: 爪哇國遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: Java dispatched envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: Java dispatched envoys presenting tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以通政院使察乃為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: On gengzi day Communications Court commissioner Chanai was made central secretariat grand councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Communications Court commissioner Chanai was made central secretariat grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，車駕幸上都。

translations.literal: On jiachen day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 命諸王也忒古不花及中書省臣兀伯都剌、察乃、善僧、許師敬、朵朵居守。

translations.literal: Prince Yetegubuhua and central secretariat officials Uburdula, Chanai, Shanseng, Xu Shijing, and Duoduo were ordered to remain and guard.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yetegubuhua and central secretariat officials Uburdula, Chanai, Shanseng, Xu Shijing, and Duoduo were ordered to remain and guard.

sentences.zh: 立典醫署，秩從五品，隸詹事院。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Palace Physicians was established, rank 5b, subordinate to the Heir Apparent's Household.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Palace Physicians was established, rank 5b, subordinate to the Heir Apparent's Household.

sentences.zh: 歸德府屬縣河決，民饑，賑糧五萬六千石。

translations.literal: Subordinate counties of Guide Prefecture suffered river breaches; the people were famished; fifty-six thousand shi of grain were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate counties of Guide Prefecture suffered river breaches; the people were famished; 56,000 shi of grain were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 河間、保定、真定三路饑，賑糧四月。

translations.literal: Hejian, Baoding, and Zhending circuits suffered famine; grain was issued for relief for four months.
translations.idiomatic: Hejian, Baoding, and Zhending circuits suffered famine; grain was issued for relief for 4 months.

sentences.zh: 建昌路饑，賑糶米三萬石。

translations.literal: Jianchang Route suffered famine; thirty thousand shi of grain were sold at reduced prices for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Jianchang Route suffered famine; 30,000 shi of grain were sold at reduced prices for relief.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳朔，帝以不雨自責，命審決重囚，遣使分祀五嶽四瀆、名山大川及京城寺觀。

translations.literal: Third month, on yisi new moon, the Emperor blamed himself for the lack of rain, ordered review and judgment of serious prisoners, and dispatched envoys to sacrifice separately at the Five Sacred Peaks, Four Watercourses, famous mountains and great rivers, and temples and abbeys in the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, on yisi new moon, the Emperor blamed himself for the lack of rain, ordered review and judgment of serious prisoners, and dispatched envoys to sacrifice separately at the Five Sacred Peaks, Four Watercourses, famous mountains and great rivers, and temples and abbeys in the capital region.

sentences.zh: 安南國宮為龍州萬戶趙雄飛等所侵，乞諭還所掠，詔廣西道遣官究之。

translations.literal: Annam's palace was invaded by Longzhou wanhu Zhao Xiongfei and others; they begged that the plundered goods be ordered returned; an edict directed Guangxi Circuit to dispatch officials to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Annam's palace was invaded by Longzhou wanhu Zhao Xiongfei and others; they begged that the plundered goods be ordered returned; an edict directed Guangxi Circuit to dispatch officials to investigate.

sentences.zh: 丙午，填星犯井宿鉞星。

translations.literal: On bingwu day Saturn encroached upon Well Scepter Star.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Saturn encroached upon Well Scepter Star.

sentences.zh: 丁未，敕百官集議急務。

translations.literal: On dingwei day the hundred officials were ordered to assemble and deliberate on urgent affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the hundred officials were ordered to assemble and deliberate on urgent affairs.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣等請汰衛士，節濫賞，罷營繕，防徭寇，諸寺官署坑冶等事歸中書，並從之。

translations.literal: Central secretariat officials and others requested reduction of guard soldiers, curbing of excessive rewards, cessation of construction and repair, defense against Yao raiders, and return of temple offices, yamens, and smelting affairs to the Central Secretariat — all were approved.
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials and others requested reduction of guard soldiers, curbing of excessive rewards, cessation of construction and repair, defense against Yao raiders, and return of temple offices, yamens, and smelting affairs to the Central Secretariat — all were approved.

sentences.zh: 壬子，翙星於司天監。

translations.literal: On renzi day a comet was observed at the Directorate of Astronomy.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day a comet was observed at the Directorate of Astronomy.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，八番巖霞洞蠻來降，願歲輸布二千五百匹，設蠻夷官鎮撫之。

translations.literal: On guichou day the barbarians of Eight Tribes Yannixia Cave submitted; they wished to deliver two thousand five hundred bolts of cloth annually; barbarian officials were established to pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the barbarians of Eight Tribes Yannixia Cave submitted; they wished to deliver 2,500 bolts of cloth annually; barbarian officials were established to pacify them.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，申禁民間金龍文織幣。

translations.literal: On yimao day the people were again forbidden to weave gold-dragon patterned silks and cloths.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the people were again forbidden to weave gold-dragon patterned silks and cloths.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，遣諸王失剌鎮北邊。

translations.literal: On dingsi day Prince Shila was dispatched to guard the northern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Prince Shila was dispatched to guard the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔安撫緬國，賜其主金幣。

translations.literal: On wuwu day an edict pacified Burma and granted its ruler gold and silks.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day an edict pacified Burma and granted its ruler gold and silks.

sentences.zh: 甲子，命功德使司簡歲修佛事一百二十七。

translations.literal: On jiazi day the Merit Affairs Commission was ordered to select one hundred twenty-seven annual Buddhist rites for repair.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Merit Affairs Commission was ordered to select 127 annual Buddhist rites for repair.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，翰林承旨阿憐帖木兒、許師敬譯《帝訓》成，更名曰《皇圖大訓》，敕授皇太子。

translations.literal: On bingyin day Hanlin academician-director Alintemur and Xu Shijing completed translating the 《Imperial Instructions》; it was renamed the 《Grand Chart of Imperial Instructions》, and an edict directed that it be conferred upon the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Hanlin academician-director Alintemur and Xu Shijing completed translating the 《Imperial Instructions》; it was renamed the 《Grand Chart of Imperial Instructions》, and an edict directed that it be conferred upon the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 考試國子生。

translations.literal: National University students were examined.
translations.idiomatic: National University students were examined.

sentences.zh: 遣僧修佛事於臨洮、鳳翔、星吉兒宗山等處。

translations.literal: Monks were dispatched to perform Buddhist rites at Lintao, Fengxiang, Xingjier Zong Mountain, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Monks were dispatched to perform Buddhist rites at Lintao, Fengxiang, Xingjier Zong Mountain, and other places.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王孛羅鐵木兒、阿剌忒納各鈔二千錠。

translations.literal: Princes Boluo Temür and Alaten were each granted two thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Princes Boluo Temür and Alaten were each granted 2,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，熒惑犯壘壁陣，填星犯井。

translations.literal: On wuchen day Mars encroached upon Rampart Wall Formation, and Saturn encroached upon Well.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Mars encroached upon Rampart Wall Formation, and Saturn encroached upon Well.

sentences.zh: 庚午，填星、太白、歲星聚於井。

translations.literal: On gengwu day Saturn, Venus, and Jupiter converged in Well.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Saturn, Venus, and Jupiter converged in Well.

sentences.zh: 辛未，泉州民阮鳳子作亂，寇陷城邑，軍民官以失討坐罪。

translations.literal: On xinwei day Ruan Fengzi of Quanzhou raised rebellion; he raided and seized walled cities; military and civilian officials were punished for failure to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Ruan Fengzi of Quanzhou raised rebellion; he raided and seized walled cities; military and civilian officials were punished for failure to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 永平、衛輝、中山、順德諸路饑，賑鈔六萬六千餘錠。

translations.literal: Yongping, Weihui, Zhongshan, and Shunde circuits suffered famine; more than sixty-six thousand ingots of notes were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Yongping, Weihui, Zhongshan, and Shunde circuits suffered famine; more than 66,000 ingots of notes were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 寧夏、奉元、建昌諸路饑，賑糧二月。

translations.literal: Ningxia, Fengyuan, and Jianchang circuits suffered famine; grain was issued for relief for two months.
translations.idiomatic: Ningxia, Fengyuan, and Jianchang circuits suffered famine; grain was issued for relief for 2 months.

sentences.zh: 大都、河間、保定、永平、濟南、常德諸路饑，免其田租之半。

translations.literal: Dadu, Hejian, Baoding, Yongping, Jinan, and Changde circuits suffered famine; half their field rents were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Dadu, Hejian, Baoding, Yongping, Jinan, and Changde circuits suffered famine; half their field rents were remitted.

sentences.zh: 四月丙戌，鎮安路總管岑修廣為弟修仁所攻，來告，命湖廣行省辨治之。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on bingxu day Zhen'an Route director-general Cen Xiuguang was attacked by his younger brother Xiuren; he came to report it; the Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to investigate and settle the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, on bingxu day Zhen'an Route director-general Cen Xiuguang was attacked by his younger brother Xiuren; he came to report it; the Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to investigate and settle the matter.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，太白犯鬼。

translations.literal: On wuxu day Venus encroached upon Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Venus encroached upon Ghost.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，熒惑犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On renyin day Mars encroached upon Rampart Wall Formation.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Mars encroached upon Rampart Wall Formation.

sentences.zh: 容米洞蠻田先什用等結十二洞蠻寇長陽縣，湖廣行省遣九姓長官彭忽都不花招之，田先什用等五洞降，余發兵討之。

translations.literal: Rongmi Cave barbarian Tian Xianshiyong and others joined twelve cave barbarians in raiding Changyang County; the Huguang Branch Secretariat dispatched Nine Surnames chief official Peng Hudubuhua to summon them; Tian Xianshiyong and others of five caves submitted, and troops were dispatched against the remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Rongmi Cave barbarian Tian Xianshiyong and others joined 12 cave barbarians in raiding Changyang County; the Huguang Branch Secretariat dispatched Nine Surnames chief official Peng Hudubuhua to summon them; Tian Xianshiyong and others of 5 caves submitted, and troops were dispatched against the remainder.

sentences.zh: 修夏津、武城河堤三十三所，役丁萬七千五百人。

translations.literal: Thirty-three river dikes at Xiajin and Wucheng were repaired; corvée laborers numbered seventeen thousand five hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: 33 river dikes at Xiajin and Wucheng were repaired; corvée laborers numbered 17,500 men.

sentences.zh: 五月甲辰朔，藩王怯別遣使來獻豹。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on jiachen new moon, Prince Qiebie dispatched envoys presenting leopards.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, on jiachen new moon, Prince Qiebie dispatched envoys presenting leopards.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，修鎮雷佛事三十一所。

translations.literal: On yisi day thirty-one Buddhist rites to avert thunder were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day 31 Buddhist rites to avert thunder were repaired.

sentences.zh: 甘肅行省臣言：「赤斤儲粟，軍士度川遠給不便，請復徙於曲尤之地。

translations.literal: Gansu branch secretariat officials said: "At Chijin grain is stored, but supplying troops across the river is inconvenient because of the distance; we request that it again be moved to Quyou.
translations.idiomatic: Gansu branch secretariat officials said, "At Chijin grain is stored, but supplying troops across the river is inconvenient because of the distance; we request that it again be moved to Quyou.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 修上都復仁門。

translations.literal: Shangdu's Furen Gate was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: Shangdu's Furen Gate was repaired.

sentences.zh: 涇州饑，禁釀酒。

translations.literal: Jing Prefecture suffered famine; wine-brewing was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Prefecture suffered famine; wine-brewing was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 罷造福建歲供蔗餳。

translations.literal: Manufacture of Fujian's annual tribute sugar syrup was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Manufacture of Fujian's annual tribute sugar syrup was abolished.

sentences.zh: 以西僧馳驛擾民，禁之。

translations.literal: Because Western monks disturbed the people by using relay stations, this was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Because Western monks disturbed the people by using relay stations, this was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，八百媳婦蠻招南道遣其子招三聽奉方物來朝。

translations.literal: On jiayin day the Eight Hundred Wives barbarians of the southern circuit dispatched their son Zhao Santing to present tribute goods at court.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Eight Hundred Wives barbarians of the southern circuit dispatched their son Zhao Santing to present tribute goods at court.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以帝師兄鎖南藏卜領西番三道宣慰司事，尚公主，錫王爵。

translations.literal: On yimao day the Imperial Preceptor's elder brother Suonanzangbu was put in charge of the three Western circuits pacification commissions, was given a princess in marriage, and was granted a princely title.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the Imperial Preceptor's elder brother Suonanzangbu was put in charge of the 3 Western circuits pacification commissions, was given a princess in marriage, and was granted a princely title.

sentences.zh: 給壽寧公主印，仍賜田百頃、鈔三萬錠。

translations.literal: Princess Shouning was granted a seal; one hundred qing of fields and thirty thousand ingots of notes were still granted.
translations.idiomatic: Princess Shouning was granted a seal; 100 qing of fields and 30,000 ingots of notes were still granted.

sentences.zh: 甲子，中書會歲鈔出納之數，請節用以補不足，從之。

translations.literal: On jiazi day the Central Secretariat reviewed the year's note receipts and disbursements and requested economizing to make up the shortfall; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Central Secretariat reviewed the year's note receipts and disbursements and requested economizing to make up the shortfall; this was approved.

sentences.zh: 監察御史劾宣撫使朵兒只班，學士李塔剌海、劉紹祖庸鄙不勝任。

translations.literal: Supervising censor impeached pacification commissioner Duorzhiban and academicians Li Talahi and Liu Shaozu as vulgar and incompetent.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising censor impeached pacification commissioner Duorzhiban and academicians Li Talahi and Liu Shaozu as vulgar and incompetent.

sentences.zh: 中書議：「三人皆勛舊子孫，罪無實狀，乞復其職，仍敕憲臺勿以空言妄劾。

translations.literal: The Central Secretariat deliberated: "All three are sons and grandsons of meritorious ministers; there are no substantiated charges; we request that their posts be restored, and that the Censorate still be directed not to impeach on empty words.
translations.idiomatic: The Central Secretariat deliberated, "All three are sons and grandsons of meritorious ministers; there are no substantiated charges; we request that their posts be restored, and that the Censorate still be directed not to impeach on empty words.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，岑世興及鎮安路岑修文合山獠、角蠻六萬餘人為寇，命湖廣、雲南行省招諭之。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Cen Shixing and Zhen'an Route's Cen Xiuwen joined mountain Liao and Jiao barbarians numbering more than sixty thousand in raiding; the Huguang and Yunnan branch secretariats were ordered to summon and instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Cen Shixing and Zhen'an Route's Cen Xiuwen joined mountain Liao and Jiao barbarians numbering more than 60,000 in raiding; the Huguang and Yunnan branch secretariats were ordered to summon and instruct them.

sentences.zh: 遣指揮使兀都蠻鐫西番咒語於居庸關崖石。

translations.literal: Commander Uduman was dispatched to inscribe Western incantations on the cliff stones at Juyong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Uduman was dispatched to inscribe Western incantations on the cliff stones at Juyong Pass.

sentences.zh: 庚午，乞住招諭永明縣五洞徭來降。

translations.literal: On gengwu day Qizhu summoned and instructed the five-cave Yao of Yongming County to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Qizhu summoned and instructed the 5-cave Yao of Yongming County to submit.

sentences.zh: 河西加木籠四部來降，以答兒麻班藏卜領卜剌麻沙朔部，公哥班領古籠羅烏公遠宗蘭宗孛兒間沙加堅部，唆南監藏卜領蘭宗古卜剌卜吉裏昔吉林亦木石威石部，朵兒只本剌領籠答吃列八里阿卜魯答思阿答藏部。

translations.literal: Four tribes of Jiamulong in Hexi submitted; Da'ermaban Zangbu was put in charge of the Buralmashuo tribe; Gonggeban was put in charge of the Gulungluo Wugong Yuanzong Lanzong Bu'erjian Shajiajian tribe; Suonanjian Zangbu was put in charge of the Lanzong Gubulabujili Xijilin Yimushi Weishi tribe; Duorzhibenla was put in charge of the Longdachilie Bali Aboludasi Adazang tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Four tribes of Jiamulong in Hexi submitted; Da'ermaban Zangbu was put in charge of the Buralmashuo tribe; Gonggeban was put in charge of the Gulungluo Wugong Yuanzong Lanzong Bu'erjian Shajiajian tribe; Suonanjian Zangbu was put in charge of the Lanzong Gubulabujili Xijilin Yimushi Weishi tribe; Duorzhibenla was put in charge of the Longdachilie Bali Aboludasi Adazang tribe.

sentences.zh: 雄州饑，太平、興化屬縣水，並賑之。

translations.literal: Xiong Prefecture suffered famine; Taiping and Xinghua subordinate counties suffered flooding — all were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong Prefecture suffered famine; Taiping and Xinghua subordinate counties suffered flooding — all were relieved.

sentences.zh: 廬州、郁林州及洪澤屯田旱，揚州路屬縣財賦官田水，並免其租。

translations.literal: Luzhou, Yulin Prefecture, and Hongze garrison fields suffered drought; fiscal and official fields in subordinate counties of Yangzhou Route suffered flooding — all their rents were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Luzhou, Yulin Prefecture, and Hongze garrison fields suffered drought; fiscal and official fields in subordinate counties of Yangzhou Route suffered flooding — all their rents were remitted.

sentences.zh: 六月癸酉朔，賜藩王怯別七寶束帶。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on guiyou new moon, Prince Qiebie was granted a seven-treasures girdle.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, on guiyou new moon, Prince Qiebie was granted a seven-treasures girdle.

sentences.zh: 以禿哈帖木兒為四川行省平章政事；

translations.literal: Tuhatiemur was made Sichuan branch secretariat grand councillor;
translations.idiomatic: Tuhatiemur was made Sichuan branch secretariat grand councillor;

sentences.zh: 請終母喪，從之。

translations.literal: he requested to complete mourning for his mother; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: he requested to complete mourning for his mother; this was approved.

sentences.zh: 癸未，播州蠻黎平愛復叛，合謝烏窮為寇，宣撫使楊燕禮不花招平愛出降。

translations.literal: On guiwei day Bozhou barbarian Li Ping'ai rebelled again; joining Xie Wuqiong he raided; pacification commissioner Yang Yanlibuhua summoned Ping'ai to come out and submit.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Bozhou barbarian Li Ping'ai rebelled again; joining Xie Wuqiong he raided; pacification commissioner Yang Yanlibuhua summoned Ping'ai to come out and submit.

sentences.zh: 烏窮不附，命湖廣行省討之。

translations.literal: Wuqiong did not submit; the Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: Wuqiong did not submit; the Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命湘寧王八剌失裏出鎮阿難答之地。

translations.literal: On dinghai day Prince of Xiangning Bala Temür was ordered to go out and guard the territory of Ananda.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Prince of Xiangning Bala Temür was ordered to go out and guard the territory of Ananda.

sentences.zh: 戊子，諸王脫脫等來朝，賜金、銀、鈔、幣有差。

translations.literal: On wuzi day Princes Toghto and others came to court; gold, silver, notes, and silks were granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Princes Toghto and others came to court; gold, silver, notes, and silks were granted in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 乙未，命梁王王禪及諸王徹徹禿鎮撫北軍，賜王禪鈔五千錠、幣帛各二百匹。

translations.literal: On yiwei day Prince of Liang Wangshan and Prince Cheche Tu were ordered to pacify the northern army; Wangshan was granted five thousand ingots of notes and two hundred bolts each of silks and cloths.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Prince of Liang Wangshan and Prince Cheche Tu were ordered to pacify the northern army; Wangshan was granted 5,000 ingots of notes and 200 bolts each of silks and cloths.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，遣道士吳全節修醮事於龍虎、三茆、閣皂三山。

translations.literal: On dingyou day the Daoist Wu Quanjie was dispatched to perform jiao rites at the three mountains of Longhu, Sanmao, and Gezao.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the Daoist Wu Quanjie was dispatched to perform jiao rites at the 3 mountains of Longhu, Sanmao, and Gezao.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，遣使祀解州鹽池神。

translations.literal: On wuxu day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the salt-pond spirit of Jie Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the salt-pond spirit of Jie Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣言：「比郡縣旱蝗，由臣等不能調燮，故災異降戒。

translations.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Recently prefectures and counties have suffered drought and locusts — this is because we could not harmonize and govern.
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "Recently prefectures and counties have suffered drought and locusts — this is because we could not harmonize and govern.

sentences.zh: 今當恐懼儆省，力行善政，亦冀陛下敬慎修德，憫恤生民。

translations.literal: Now we ought to be fearful and examine ourselves, exert ourselves in good government, and also hope that Your Majesty will respectfully and cautiously cultivate virtue and pity and succor the living people.
translations.idiomatic: Now we ought to be fearful and examine ourselves, exert ourselves in good government, and also hope that Your Majesty will respectfully and cautiously cultivate virtue and pity and succor the living people.

sentences.zh: 」帝嘉納之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor commended and approved it.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor commended and approved it.

sentences.zh: 賑昌王八剌失裏部鈔四萬錠，賜吳王潑皮鈔萬錠。

translations.literal: Forty thousand ingots of notes were issued to relieve Prince of Chang Bala Temür's following; Prince of Wu Pobi was granted ten thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: 40,000 ingots of notes were issued to relieve Prince of Chang Bala Temür's following; Prince of Wu Pobi was granted 10,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 己亥，納皇姊壽寧公主女撒答八剌於中宮。

translations.literal: On jihai day the daughter of the Emperor's elder sister Princess Shouning, Sadabala, was received into the central palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the daughter of the Emperor's elder sister Princess Shouning, Sadabala, was received into the central palace.

sentences.zh: 道州路櫟所源徭為寇，命乞住督兵捕之。

translations.literal: Yao of Lisuo Source in Daozhou Route became bandits; Qizhu was ordered to supervise troops to capture them.
translations.idiomatic: Yao of Lisuo Source in Daozhou Route became bandits; Qizhu was ordered to supervise troops to capture them.

sentences.zh: 奉元、鞏昌屬縣大雨雹，峽州旱，東平屬縣蝗，大同屬縣大水，萊蕪等處冶戶饑，賑鈔三萬錠。

translations.literal: Subordinate counties of Fengyuan and Gongchang suffered heavy rain and hail; Xia Prefecture had drought; subordinate counties of Dongping had locusts; subordinate counties of Datong had great flooding; smelting households at Laiwu and elsewhere suffered famine; thirty thousand ingots of notes were granted in relief.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate counties of Fengyuan and Gongchang suffered heavy rain and hail; Xia Prefecture had drought; subordinate counties of Dongping had locusts; subordinate counties of Datong had great flooding; smelting households at Laiwu and elsewhere suffered famine; 30,000 ingots of notes were granted in relief.

sentences.zh: 光州水，中山安喜縣雨雹傷稼，大昌屯河決，大寧、廬州、德安、梧州、中慶諸路屬縣水旱，並蠲其租。

translations.literal: Guang Prefecture had flooding; Anxi County of Zhongshan suffered hail damaging crops; the Dachang Tuntun River burst its banks; subordinate counties of Daining, Lu, De'an, Wu, and Zhongqing routes suffered flood and drought; all had rents remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Guang Prefecture had flooding; Anxi County of Zhongshan suffered hail damaging crops; the Dachang Tuntun River burst its banks; subordinate counties of Daining, Lu, De'an, Wu, and Zhongqing routes suffered flood and drought; all had rents remitted.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，車駕發上都，禁車騎踐民禾。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, on jiachen day the imperial carriage departed Shangdu; riding in chariots and on horses was forbidden to trample the people's grain.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month of autumn, on jiachen day the imperial carriage departed Shangdu; riding in chariots and on horses was forbidden to trample the people's grain.

sentences.zh: 遼王脫脫請復太母月也倫宮守兵及女直屯戶，不允。

translations.literal: Liao King Tuotuo requested restoration of garrison troops for Grand Empress Dowager Yeyelun's palace and Jurchen tuntun households; not approved.
translations.idiomatic: Liao King Tuotuo requested restoration of garrison troops for Grand Empress Dowager Yeyelun's palace and Jurchen tuntun households; not approved.

sentences.zh: 增給太祖四大斡耳朵歲賜銀二百錠、鈔八千錠。

translations.literal: The annual grants to Taizu's four great ordos were increased by two hundred ingots of silver and eight thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: The annual grants to Taizu's four great ordos were increased by 200 ingots of silver and 8,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 遣使祀海神天妃。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the sea god Tianfei.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the sea god Tianfei.

sentences.zh: 造豢豹氈車三十輛。

translations.literal: Thirty felt carts for rearing leopards were constructed.
translations.idiomatic: 30 felt carts for rearing leopards were constructed.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，怯憐口屯田霜，賑糧二月。

translations.literal: On yisi day qielian tuntian fields suffered frost; two months' grain was granted in relief.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day qielian tuntian fields suffered frost; 2 months' grain was granted in relief.

sentences.zh: 丙午，享太廟。

translations.literal: On bingwu day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丁未，紹慶酉陽寨冉世昌及何惹洞蠻為寇。

translations.literal: On dingwei day Ran Shichang of Youyang Stockade in Shaoqing and He're Cave barbarians became bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Ran Shichang of Youyang Stockade in Shaoqing and He're Cave barbarians became bandits.

sentences.zh: 詔行宮駝馬及宗戚將校駐冬北邊者，毋輒至京師。

translations.literal: Edict: palace camels and horses and imperial kin and generals stationed for winter on the northern frontier shall not come to the capital without authorization.
translations.idiomatic: Edict: palace camels and horses and imperial kin and generals stationed for winter on the northern frontier shall not come to the capital without authorization.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，封阿都赤為綏寧王，賜鈔四千錠，給金印。

translations.literal: On xinhai day Aduchi was enfeoffed Prince of Suining and granted four thousand ingots of notes; a gold seal was given.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Aduchi was enfeoffed Prince of Suining and granted 4,000 ingots of notes; a gold seal was given.

sentences.zh: 壬子，皇后受牙蠻答哥戒於水晶殿。

translations.literal: On renzi day the Empress received the Yaman Dagha precepts at the Crystal Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day the Empress received the Yaman Dagha precepts at the Crystal Hall.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，幸大乾元寺，敕鑄五方佛銅像。

translations.literal: On jiayin day the Emperor visited Dagan Yuan Temple and ordered casting of bronze images of the Five Direction Buddhas.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Emperor visited Dagan Yuan Temple and ordered casting of bronze images of the Five Direction Buddhas.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔翰林侍講學士阿魯威、直學士燕赤譯《世祖聖訓》，以備經筵進講。

translations.literal: On yimao day an edict directed Hanlin exposition academician Aruwei and regular academician Yanchi to translate The Holy Instructions of Shizu for presentation at the classics mat lectures.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day an edict directed Hanlin exposition academician Aruwei and regular academician Yanchi to translate The Holy Instructions of Shizu for presentation at the classics mat lectures.

sentences.zh: 戊午，諸王不賽因獻駝馬。

translations.literal: On wuwu day Prince Busain presented camels and horses.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Prince Busain presented camels and horses.

sentences.zh: 遣日本僧瑞興等四十人還國。

translations.literal: Forty Japanese monks including Ruixing were dispatched to return to their country.
translations.idiomatic: 40 Japanese monks including Ruixing were dispatched to return to their country.

sentences.zh: 作別殿於潛邸。

translations.literal: A separate hall was built at the latent residence.
translations.idiomatic: A separate hall was built at the latent residence.

sentences.zh: 敕：「入粟拜官者，準致仕銓格。

translations.literal: Edict: "Those who donate grain for appointment to office shall be assessed according to the criteria for retired officials.
translations.idiomatic: Edict: "Those who donate grain for appointment to office shall be assessed according to the criteria for retired officials.

sentences.zh: 」己未，禁諸部王妃入京告饑。

translations.literal: " On jiwei day princesses of the various princely establishments were forbidden to enter the capital to report famine.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day princesses of the various princely establishments were forbidden to enter the capital to report famine.

sentences.zh: 以月魯帖木兒嗣齊王，給金印。

translations.literal: Yelü Temür inherited the enfeoffment as Prince of Qi; a gold seal was given.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Temür inherited the enfeoffment as Prince of Qi; a gold seal was given.

sentences.zh: 八百媳婦蠻招南通遣使來獻馴象方物。

translations.literal: The Babai Xifu barbarians of Zhaonantong sent envoys presenting tribute of tame elephants and local products.
translations.idiomatic: The Babai Xifu barbarians of Zhaonantong sent envoys presenting tribute of tame elephants and local products.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，發兵修野狐、色澤、桑乾三嶺道。

translations.literal: On yichou day troops were dispatched to repair the three mountain pass roads of Yehu, Seze, and Sanggan.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day troops were dispatched to repair the three mountain pass roads of Yehu, Seze, and Sanggan.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，太白經天。

translations.literal: On wuchen day Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Venus crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 己巳，大理土官你囊來獻方物。

translations.literal: On jisi day Ninang, native official of Dali, came to present local products.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Ninang, native official of Dali, came to present local products.

sentences.zh: 庚申，廣西宣慰副使王瑞請益戍兵，及以土民屯田備蠻，仍置南寧安撫司。

translations.literal: On gengshen day Guangxi branch pacification vice commissioner Wang Rui requested increased garrison troops and that native people conduct tuntian farming to guard against barbarians; the Nanning Pacification Commission was also established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Guangxi branch pacification vice commissioner Wang Rui requested increased garrison troops and that native people conduct tuntian farming to guard against barbarians; the Nanning Pacification Commission was also established.

sentences.zh: 河決鄭州、陽武縣，漂民萬六千五百餘家，賑之。

translations.literal: The Yellow River burst its banks at Zheng Prefecture and Yangwu County, sweeping away more than sixteen thousand five hundred households; relief was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River burst its banks at Zheng Prefecture and Yangwu County, sweeping away more than 16,500 households; relief was granted.

sentences.zh: 永平、大都諸屬縣水，大風，雨雹。

translations.literal: Subordinate counties of Yongping and Dadu had flooding, great wind, and hail.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate counties of Yongping and Dadu had flooding, great wind, and hail.

sentences.zh: 龍興、辰州二路火，大名、永平、奉元諸路屬縣旱，汴梁路水，大名、順德、衛輝、淮安等路，睢、趙、涿、霸等州及諸位屯田蝗，大同渾源河溢，檀、順等州兩河決，溫榆水溢，賑永平、奉元鈔七萬錠。

translations.literal: Longxing and Chen Prefecture routes had fire; Daye, Yongping, Fengyuan, and other route subordinate counties had drought; Bianliang Route had flooding; Daye, Shunde, Weihui, Huai'an routes and Sui, Zhao, Zhuo, Ba prefectures and princely estate tuntian had locusts; Datong's Hunyuan River overflowed; Tan and Shun prefectures had two rivers burst; Wenyu River overflowed; seventy thousand ingots of notes were granted in relief to Yongping and Fengyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Longxing and Chen Prefecture routes had fire; Daye, Yongping, Fengyuan, and other route subordinate counties had drought; Bianliang Route had flooding; Daye, Shunde, Weihui, Huai'an routes and Sui, Zhao, Zhuo, Ba prefectures and princely estate tuntian had locusts; Datong's Hunyuan River overflowed; Tan and Shun prefectures had two rivers burst; Wenyu River overflowed; 70,000 ingots of notes were granted in relief to Yongping and Fengyuan.

sentences.zh: 賑糶濠州饑民麥三萬九千餘石。

translations.literal: Thirty-nine thousand-plus shi of wheat were issued and sold at reduced prices to relieve the famished people of Hao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: 39,000-plus shi of wheat were issued and sold at reduced prices to relieve the famished people of Hao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 命瘞京城外棄骸，死狀不白者，有司究之。

translations.literal: Orders were issued to bury abandoned corpses outside the capital; where cause of death was unclear, officials were to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Orders were issued to bury abandoned corpses outside the capital; where cause of death was unclear, officials were to investigate.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌，兀伯都剌、許師敬並以災變饑歉乞解政柄，不允。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on jiaxu day Wubadu and Xu Shijing both requested resignation of their administrative authority on account of calamities, famine, and crop failure; not approved.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, on jiaxu day Wubadu and Xu Shijing both requested resignation of their administrative authority on account of calamities, famine, and crop failure; not approved.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，遣乃馬臺簡閱邊兵，賜鈔千錠。

translations.literal: On yihai day Namatai was dispatched to inspect frontier troops; one thousand ingots of notes were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Namatai was dispatched to inspect frontier troops; 1,000 ingots of notes were granted.

sentences.zh: 大天源延聖寺神御殿成。

translations.literal: The Spirit Hall at Datianyuan Yansheng Temple was completed.
translations.idiomatic: The Spirit Hall at Datianyuan Yansheng Temple was completed.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，修澄清石閘。

translations.literal: On wuyin day the Chengqingshi Sluice Gate was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the Chengqingshi Sluice Gate was repaired.

sentences.zh: 甲申，享太廟。

translations.literal: On jiashen day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 長春宮道士藍道元以罪被黜。

translations.literal: Daoist priest Lan Daoyuan of Changchun Palace was dismissed on account of crime.

translations.idiomatic: Toujiang Tuan Yao in Guangxi raided; pacification commissioner Mainu induced them to submit.

translations.idiomatic: Fuling, Qingxi, Litou and other Yuan barbarians raided; the Huguang branch secretariat dispatched envoys to induce them to submit.

sentences.zh: 戊午，造中統、至元鈔各十萬錠。

translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day 100,000 ingots each of Zhongtong and Zhiyuan notes were minted.

translations.idiomatic: Prince Temür Buqa was enfeoffed Prince of Zhennan to garrison Yangzhou.

translations.literal: On xinyou day censor-in-chief Niuzhe was additionally granted commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day censor-in-chief Niuzhe was additionally granted commissioner with the Ceremonial Standing Equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 加封廬陵江神曰顯應。

translations.literal: The Lu-ling River god was posthumously enfeoffed as Xianying.
translations.idiomatic: The Lu-ling River god was posthumously enfeoffed as Xianying.

sentences.zh: 弛成都酒禁。

translations.literal: The liquor prohibition in Chengdu was relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: The liquor prohibition in Chengdu was relaxed.

sentences.zh: 播州蠻宋王保來降。

translations.literal: Bozhou barbarian Song Wangbao came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Bozhou barbarian Song Wangbao came to submit.

sentences.zh: 己巳，徙上都清寧殿於伯亦兒行宮。

translations.literal: On jisi day Shangdu's Qingning Hall was relocated to the Bo'er travel-palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Shangdu's Qingning Hall was relocated to the Bo'er travel-palace.

sentences.zh: 弛永平路山澤之禁。

translations.literal: The prohibition on mountains and marshes in Yongping Route was relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: The prohibition on mountains and marshes in Yongping Route was relaxed.

sentences.zh: 階州土蕃為寇，武靖王遣臨洮路元帥盞盞諭降之。

translations.literal: Tibetan barbarians of Jie Prefecture raided; the Martial and Tranquil King dispatched Lintao Route commander Zhanzhan to induce them to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetan barbarians of Jie Prefecture raided; the Martial and Tranquil King dispatched Lintao Route commander Zhanzhan to induce them to submit.

sentences.zh: 廣寧路屬縣霖雨傷稼，賑鈔三萬錠。

translations.literal: Subordinate counties of Guangning Route suffered protracted rains that harmed the crops; thirty thousand ingots of notes were granted in relief.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate counties of Guangning Route suffered protracted rains that harmed the crops; 30,000 ingots of notes were granted in relief.

sentences.zh: 沔陽府旱，免其稅。

translations.literal: Mianyang Prefecture suffered drought; its tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Mianyang Prefecture suffered drought; its tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 永平路大水，免其租，仍賑糧四月。

translations.literal: Yongping Route suffered great flooding; its land tax was remitted and grain relief was granted for four months.
translations.idiomatic: Yongping Route suffered great flooding; its land tax was remitted and grain relief was granted for 4 months.

sentences.zh: 汴梁、建康、太平、池州諸路及甘肅亦集乃路饑，並賑之。

translations.literal: Bianliang, Jiankang, Taiping, Chizhou and other routes and Gansu's Yijina'i Route suffered famine; all were granted relief.
translations.idiomatic: Bianliang, Jiankang, Taiping, Chizhou and other routes and Gansu's Yijina'i Route suffered famine; all were granted relief.

sentences.zh: 錦州水溢，壞田千頃，漂死者百人，人給鈔一錠。

translations.literal: Jin Prefecture's waters overflowed, ruining one thousand qing of fields and drowning one hundred people; one ingot of notes was granted per person.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Prefecture's waters overflowed, ruining 1,000 qing of fields and drowning 100 people; 1 ingot of notes was granted per person.

sentences.zh: 崇明州海溢，漂民舍五百家，賑糧一月，給死者鈔二十貫。

translations.literal: Chongming Prefecture's sea overflowed, washing away five hundred households; grain relief was granted for one month and twenty strings of notes per deceased.
translations.idiomatic: Chongming Prefecture's sea overflowed, washing away 500 households; grain relief was granted for 1 month and 20 strings of notes per deceased.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁丑，諸王月思別獻文豹，賜金、銀、鈔、幣有差。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on dingchou day Prince Yuesibie presented a literary leopard; gold, silver, notes, and silks were granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on dingchou day Prince Yuesibie presented a literary leopard; gold, silver, notes, and silks were granted in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 御史哈剌那海請擇正人傅太子，帝嘉納之。

translations.literal: Censor Hala Nuhai requested selecting upright men to tutor the crown prince; the Emperor praised and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Hala Nuhai requested selecting upright men to tutor the crown prince; the Emperor praised and accepted it.

sentences.zh: 壬午，御史賈垕請祔武宗皇后於太廟，不報。

translations.literal: On renwu day censor Jia Xu requested enshrining Empress Wuzong in the Grand Ancestral Temple — no response.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day censor Jia Xu requested enshrining Empress Wuzong in the Grand Ancestral Temple — no response.

sentences.zh: 敕以來年元夕構燈山於內廷，御史趙師魯以水旱請罷其事，從之。

translations.literal: An edict directed that next year on Lantern Festival a lamp-mountain be built within the inner court; censor Zhao Shilu requested its cancellation because of flood and drought — approved.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed that next year on Lantern Festival a lamp-mountain be built within the inner court; censor Zhao Shilu requested its cancellation because of flood and drought — approved.

sentences.zh: 甲申，師魯又請親祀郊廟，帝嘉納之。

translations.literal: On jiashen day Shilu again requested the Emperor personally sacrifice at the suburban altars and ancestral temple; the Emperor praised and accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Shilu again requested the Emperor personally sacrifice at the suburban altars and ancestral temple; the Emperor praised and accepted it.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以回回陰陽家言天變，給鈔二千錠，施有道行者及乞人，系囚，以禳之。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, because Muslim yin-yang masters spoke of celestial changes, two thousand ingots of notes were distributed to virtuous practitioners and beggars and to imprisoned persons, to avert calamity.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, because Muslim yin-yang masters spoke of celestial changes, 2,000 ingots of notes were distributed to virtuous practitioners and beggars and to imprisoned persons, to avert calamity.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，寧夏路地震，有聲如雷，連震者四。

translations.literal: On dinghai day Ningxia Route suffered earthquake with sound like thunder, shaking four times in succession.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Ningxia Route suffered earthquake with sound like thunder, shaking 4 times in succession.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，赦天下。

translations.literal: On gengyin day amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 召江浙行省右丞趙簡為集賢大學士，領經筵事。

translations.literal: Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat right vice director Zhao Jian was summoned as Hall of Worthies grand academician to head the classics colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat right vice director Zhao Jian was summoned as Hall of Worthies grand academician to head the classics colloquium.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，賜梁王王禪宴器金銀。

translations.literal: On renchen day gold and silver banquet vessels were granted to Prince of Liang Wang Chan.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day gold and silver banquet vessels were granted to Prince of Liang Wang Chan.

sentences.zh: 以皇子小薛夜啼，賜高年鈔。

translations.literal: Because the imperial son Xiaoxue cried at night, notes were granted to the elderly.
translations.idiomatic: Because the imperial son Xiaoxue cried at night, notes were granted to the elderly.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，作鹿頂殿。

translations.literal: On guisi day the Deer-Peak Hall was built.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the Deer-Peak Hall was built.

sentences.zh: 己亥，命帝師修佛事，釋重囚三人。

translations.literal: On jihai day the Imperial Preceptor was ordered to perform Buddhist rites and release three serious prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the Imperial Preceptor was ordered to perform Buddhist rites and release 3 serious prisoners.

sentences.zh: 置大承華普慶寺總管府，罷規運提點所。

translations.literal: The Dacheng Hua Puqing Temple chief steward's office was established; the Guiyun transport intendant's office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Dacheng Hua Puqing Temple chief steward's office was established; the Guiyun transport intendant's office was abolished.

translations.literal: Censors said: "In recent years construction projects have used guard troops for corvée labor, neglecting military training.
translations.idiomatic: Censors said: "In recent years construction projects have used guard troops for corvée labor, neglecting military training.

sentences.zh: 請遵世祖舊制，教習五衛親軍，以備扈從。

translations.literal: We request following Emperor Shizu's old system in drilling the Five Guards' personal troops, for escort duty.
translations.idiomatic: We request following Emperor Shizu's old system in drilling the Five Guards' personal troops, for escort duty.

sentences.zh: 」不報。

translations.idiomatic: " Not granted.

translations.literal: Huguang garrison thousand-household Zhigan Buhua induced Fuling Cave barbarian Liu Ji and others to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Huguang garrison thousand-household Zhigan Buhua induced Fuling Cave barbarian Liu Ji and others to submit.

translations.literal: Baoding Route suffered famine; eighty-one thousand five hundred shi of grain were granted in relief.
translations.idiomatic: Baoding Route suffered famine; 81,500 shi of grain were granted in relief.

sentences.zh: 懷慶路饑，賑鈔四萬錠。

translations.literal: Huaqing Route suffered famine; forty thousand ingots of notes were granted in relief.
translations.idiomatic: Huaqing Route suffered famine; 40,000 ingots of notes were granted in relief.

sentences.zh: 亳州河溢，漂民舍八百餘家，壞田二千三百頃，免其租。

translations.idiomatic: Boz Prefecture's river overflowed, washing away more than 800 households, ruining 2,300 qing of fields; the land tax was remitted.

translations.literal: Guangxi's Jingjiang, Xiang Prefecture and other routes and Liaoyang Route suffered famine; all were granted relief.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi's Jingjiang, Xiang Prefecture and other routes and Liaoyang Route suffered famine; all were granted relief.

sentences.zh: 大寧路大水，壞田五千五百頃，漂民舍八百餘家，溺死者人給鈔一錠。

translations.literal: Daning Route suffered great flooding, ruining five thousand five hundred qing of fields and washing away more than eight hundred households; one ingot of notes was granted per drowned person.
translations.idiomatic: Daning Route suffered great flooding, ruining 5,500 qing of fields and washing away more than 800 households; 1 ingot of notes was granted per drowned person.

translations.literal: Fourth year, first month, on jiachen day Prince Mainu came to court; he was granted one ingot of gold, ten ingots of silver, two thousand ingots of notes, and forty bolts each of silks.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year, first month, on jiachen day Prince Mainu came to court; he was granted 1 ingot of gold, 10 ingots of silver, 2,000 ingots of notes, and 40 bolts each of silks.

translations.idiomatic: " On jiwei day Venus encroached upon Ox.

translations.idiomatic: On renzi day the Central Palace's gold, silver, and iron smelters were returned to the central secretariat.

sentences.zh: 靖安王闊不花出鎮陜西，賜鈔二千錠。

translations.literal: Prince of Jing'an Kuo Buhua proceeded to garrison Shaanxi; two thousand ingots of notes were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jing'an Kuo Buhua proceeded to garrison Shaanxi; 2,000 ingots of notes were granted.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，賜諸王阿剌忒納失裏等鈔六千錠。

translations.literal: On guichou day Princes Alatenashili and others were granted six thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Princes Alatenashili and others were granted 6,000 ingots of notes.

translations.literal: On jiayin day falconer Toto'er fell ill; one thousand ingots of notes were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day falconer Toto'er fell ill; 1,000 ingots of notes were granted.

sentences.zh: 戊午，命市珠寶首飾。

translations.literal: On wuwu day purchase of pearl and jewel ornaments was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day purchase of pearl and jewel ornaments was ordered.

sentences.zh: 庚申，皇子允丹藏卜受佛戒於智泉寺。

translations.literal: On gengshen day imperial son Yundan Zangbu received Buddhist precepts at Zhi Spring Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day imperial son Yundan Zangbu received Buddhist precepts at Zhi Spring Temple.

translations.literal: Yanguan Prefecture's sea waters overflowed, ruining more than two thousand paces of sea-dike.
translations.idiomatic: Yanguan Prefecture's sea waters overflowed, ruining more than 2,000 paces of sea-dike.

sentences.zh: 甲子，武龍洞蠻寇武緣縣諸堡。

translations.literal: On jiazi day Wulong Cave barbarians raided fortresses of Wuyuan County.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Wulong Cave barbarians raided fortresses of Wuyuan County.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，燕南廉訪司請立真定常平倉，不報。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Yan South surveillance commission requested establishing a Changping granary in Zhending; no response.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Yan South surveillance commission requested establishing a Changping granary in Zhending; no response.

translations.idiomatic: The Huitong Canal was dredged and the Huozhou granary-protection dike was built, employing 30,000 corvée laborers.

sentences.zh: 初置雲南行省檢校官。

translations.literal: The verifying officer of the Yunnan branch secretariat was established for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: The verifying officer of the Yunnan branch secretariat was established for the first time.

sentences.zh: 遼陽行省諸郡饑，賑鈔十八萬錠。

translations.idiomatic: Various commanderies of the Liaoyang branch secretariat suffered famine; 180,000 ingots of notes were granted in relief.

sentences.zh: 彰德、淮安、揚州諸路饑，並賑之。

translations.literal: Zhangde, Huai'an, Yangzhou and other routes suffered famine; all were granted relief.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangde, Huai'an, Yangzhou and other routes suffered famine; all were granted relief.

sentences.zh: 大寧路水，給溺死者人鈔一錠。

translations.literal: Daning Route suffered flooding; one ingot of notes was granted per drowned person.
translations.idiomatic: Daning Route suffered flooding; 1 ingot of notes was granted per drowned person.

sentences.zh: 二月辛未，祀先農。

translations.literal: Second month, on xinwei day the former agriculturist was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, on xinwei day the former agriculturist was sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，祭太祖、太宗、睿宗御容於大承華普慶寺，以翰林院官執事。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day the spirit portraits of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong were sacrificed to at Dacheng Hua Puqing Temple, with Hanlin Academy officials officiating.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the spirit portraits of Taizu, Taizong, and Ruizong were sacrificed to at Dacheng Hua Puqing Temple, with Hanlin Academy officials officiating.

translations.idiomatic: On yihai day imperial prince Yesen Temür proceeded to garrison the northern frontier; he was granted 1 ingot of gold, 5 ingots of silver, 500 ingots of notes, and 10 bolts each of silks.

translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Yiliechi was ordered to take charge of Renzong's spirit hall; grand steward Yilianzhen Kirisi was made darughachi of the Dacheng Hua Puqing Temple chief steward's office, remaining grand steward.

sentences.zh: 壬午，狩於漷州。

translations.literal: On renwu day the Emperor hunted at Huozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the Emperor hunted at Huozhou.

sentences.zh: 諸王火沙、河榮、答裏出鎮北邊，賜金、銀、鈔、幣有差。

translations.literal: Princes Huosha, Herong, and Dali proceeded to garrison the northern frontier; gold, silver, notes, and silks were granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Princes Huosha, Herong, and Dali proceeded to garrison the northern frontier; gold, silver, notes, and silks were granted in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 帝師參馬亦思吉思卜長出亦思宅卜卒，命塔失鐵木兒、紐澤監修佛事。

translations.literal: The Imperial Preceptor Sakya Yeshe Gyaltsen Changba Yeshe Odzer died; Tash Temür and Niuzhe were ordered to supervise Buddhist rites.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Preceptor Sakya Yeshe Gyaltsen Changba Yeshe Odzer died; Tash Temür and Niuzhe were ordered to supervise Buddhist rites.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔同僉樞密院事燕帖木兒教閱諸衛軍。

translations.literal: On bingxu day associate privy council administrator Yan Temür was ordered to drill the guard armies.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day associate privy council administrator Yan Temür was ordered to drill the guard armies.

sentences.zh: 戊子，進襲封衍聖公孔思晦階嘉議大夫。

translations.literal: On wuzi day hereditary Yansheng Duke Kong Sihui was promoted to the rank of Jiayi dafu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day hereditary Yansheng Duke Kong Sihui was promoted to the rank of Jiayi dafu.

sentences.zh: 以馬思忽為雲南行省平章政事，提調烏蒙屯田。

translations.literal: Masihu was made Yunnan branch secretariat grand councillor, supervising Wumeng garrison agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: Masihu was made Yunnan branch secretariat grand councillor, supervising Wumeng garrison agriculture.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，八百媳婦蠻酋招南通來獻方物。

translations.literal: On gengyin day the chieftain Zhaonantong of the Eight Hundred Wives barbarians came to present tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the chieftain Zhaonantong of the Eight Hundred Wives barbarians came to present tribute goods.

translations.literal: On xinmao day a white rainbow pierced the sun; the Palace Provision chief steward's office and the Cloud-Requisition chief steward's office were subordinated to the Shangdu commissioner for custody.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day a white rainbow pierced the sun; the Palace Provision chief steward's office and the Cloud-Requisition chief steward's office were subordinated to the Shangdu commissioner for custody.

translations.idiomatic: Fengyuan, Luzhou, Huai'an and other routes and the Baideng tribe suffered famine; grain relief was granted in varying amounts.

translations.literal: Yongping Route suffered famine; thirty thousand ingots of notes and two months' grain were granted in relief.
translations.idiomatic: Yongping Route suffered famine; 30,000 ingots of notes and 2 months' grain were granted in relief.
