translations.idiomatic: Third month, on xinchou day imperial son Yundan Zangbu proceeded to garrison the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 以那海赤為惠國公，商議內史府事。

translations.literal: Naghai Chi was made Duke of Hui State and deliberated Inner Secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Naghai Chi was made Duke of Hui State and deliberated Inner Secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，和寧地震，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: On guimao day Hening suffered earthquake with sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Hening suffered earthquake with sound like thunder.

sentences.zh: 丙午，廷試進士阿察赤、李黼等八十五人，賜進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: On bingwu day eighty-five jinshi examinees including Achachi and Li Fu passed the palace examination; jinshi with honors and with regular passes were granted in varying ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day 85 jinshi examinees including Achachi and Li Fu passed the palace examination; jinshi with honors and with regular passes were granted in varying ranks.

sentences.zh: 命西僧作止風佛事。

translations.literal: Western monks were ordered to perform wind-stilling Buddhist rites.
translations.idiomatic: Western monks were ordered to perform wind-stilling Buddhist rites.

sentences.zh: 潮州路判官錢珍，挑推官梁楫妻劉氏，不從，誣楫下獄殺之。

translations.literal: Chaozhou Route judge Qian Zhen harassed and assaulted the wife Liu of assistant magistrate Liang Qi; when she refused, he falsely charged Liang and imprisoned and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Chaozhou Route judge Qian Zhen harassed and assaulted the wife Liu of assistant magistrate Liang Qi; when she refused, he falsely charged Liang and imprisoned and killed him.

sentences.zh: 事覺，珍飲藥死，詔戮屍傳首。

translations.literal: When the matter came to light, Zhen took poison and died; an edict ordered his corpse dismembered and the head displayed.
translations.idiomatic: When the matter came to light, Zhen took poison and died; an edict ordered his corpse dismembered and the head displayed.

sentences.zh: 海北廉訪副使劉安仁，坐受珍賂除名。

translations.literal: Haibei surveillance vice commissioner Liu Anren was stripped of office for accepting Zhen's bribes.
translations.idiomatic: Haibei surveillance vice commissioner Liu Anren was stripped of office for accepting Zhen's bribes.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，諸王槊思班、不賽亦等，以文豹、西馬、佩刀、珠寶等物來獻，賜金、鈔萬計。

translations.literal: On xinhai day Princes Shuosiban, Busaiyi, and others came to present literary leopards, western horses, girdle swords, pearls, jewels, and other goods; gold and notes were granted by the ten-thousands.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Princes Shuosiban, Busaiyi, and others came to present literary leopards, western horses, girdle swords, pearls, jewels, and other goods; gold and notes were granted by the ten-thousands.

sentences.zh: 庚申，遣使往江南求奇花異果。

translations.literal: On gengshen day envoys were dispatched to the Jiangnan region to seek rare flowers and exotic fruits.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day envoys were dispatched to the Jiangnan region to seek rare flowers and exotic fruits.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以太傅朵臺為太師，太保禿忽魯為太傅，也可紥魯忽赤伯達沙為太保。

translations.literal: On xinyou day grand preceptor Duotai was made grand tutor, grand guardian Tuhulu was made grand preceptor, and yeke jarquchi Botash was made grand guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day grand preceptor Duotai was made grand tutor, grand guardian Tuhulu was made grand preceptor, and yeke jarquchi Botash was made grand guardian.

sentences.zh: 敕前太師伯忽與議大事，食其俸終身。

translations.literal: An edict directed former grand tutor Boghu to deliberate great affairs and receive his stipend for life.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed former grand tutor Boghu to deliberate great affairs and receive his stipend for life.

sentences.zh: 召翰林學士承旨蔡國公張珪、集賢大學士廉恂、太子賓客王毅，悉復舊職，陜西行臺中丞敬儼為集賢大學士，並商議中書省事，珪仍預經筵事。

translations.literal: Hanlin academician-director Duke of Cai State Zhang Gui, Hall of Worthies grand academician Lian Xun, and crown prince mentor Wang Yi were all restored to their former offices; Shaanxi branch censorate vice director Jing Yan was made Hall of Worthies grand academician; all deliberated central secretariat affairs — Gui still attended the classics colloquium.
translations.idiomatic: Hanlin academician-director Duke of Cai State Zhang Gui, Hall of Worthies grand academician Lian Xun, and crown prince mentor Wang Yi were all restored to their former offices; Shaanxi branch censorate vice director Jing Yan was made Hall of Worthies grand academician; all deliberated central secretariat affairs — Gui still attended the classics colloquium.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王火沙部鈔四千錠。

translations.literal: Prince Huosha's division was granted four thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Huosha's division was granted 4,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 郡王朵來、兀魯兀等部畜牧災，賑鈔三萬五千錠。

translations.literal: Commandery kings Duolai, Ulugu, and others' divisions suffered livestock disaster; thirty-five thousand ingots of notes were granted in relief.
translations.idiomatic: Commandery kings Duolai, Ulugu, and others' divisions suffered livestock disaster; 35,000 ingots of notes were granted in relief.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣請酬哈散等累朝售寶價鈔十萬二千錠，從之。

translations.literal: Members of the Central Secretariat requested payment in notes of one hundred two thousand ingots as the price for treasures sold over successive reigns by Hasan and others; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Members of the Central Secretariat requested payment in notes of 102,000 ingots as the price for treasures sold over successive reigns by Hasan and others; it was approved.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，車駕幸上都。

translations.literal: On renxu day the imperial carriage visited Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day the imperial carriage visited Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 復設武備寺同判六員。

translations.literal: Six deputy directors of the Armory Directorate were again established.
translations.idiomatic: Six deputy directors of the Armory Directorate were again established.

sentences.zh: 命親王八剌失裏出鎮察罕腦兒。

translations.literal: Prince Bala Temür was ordered to go out and garrison Chaghan Na'ur.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Bala Temür was ordered to go out and garrison Chaghan Na'ur.

sentences.zh: 封寬徹為國公，以阿散火者知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Kuanche was enfeoffed Duke of the State, and Ashan Huozhe was appointed to manage Privy Council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Kuanche was enfeoffed Duke of the State, and Ashan Huozhe was appointed to manage Privy Council affairs.

sentences.zh: 渾河決，發軍民萬人塞之。

translations.literal: The Hun River burst its banks; ten thousand troops and civilians were mobilized to block it.
translations.idiomatic: The Hun River burst its banks; 10,000 troops and civilians were mobilized to block it.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，熒惑犯井。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Mars encroached upon Well.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Mars encroached upon Well.

sentences.zh: 復置衛候直都指揮使司，秩正四品。

translations.literal: The Imperial Carriage Guard Direct Command was reestablished at the rank of regular fourth grade.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Carriage Guard Direct Command was reestablished at the rank of regular fourth grade.

sentences.zh: 諸王不賽因遣使獻文豹、獅子，賜鈔八千錠。

translations.literal: Prince Busayin dispatched envoys presenting a leopard and a lion; eight thousand ingots of notes were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Busayin dispatched envoys presenting a leopard and a lion; 8,000 ingots of notes were granted.

sentences.zh: 大寧、廣平二路屬縣饑，賑鈔二萬八千錠。

translations.literal: Dependent counties of the two routes Daning and Guangping suffered famine; twenty-eight thousand ingots of notes were granted in relief.
translations.idiomatic: Dependent counties of the two routes Daning and Guangping suffered famine; 28,000 ingots of notes were granted in relief.

sentences.zh: 河南行省諸州縣及建康屬縣饑，賑糧有差。

translations.literal: Various prefectures and counties of Henan Province and dependent counties of Jianning suffered famine; relief grain was granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Various prefectures and counties of Henan Province and dependent counties of Jianning suffered famine; relief grain was granted in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛未，盜入太廟，竊武宗金主及祭器。

translations.literal: Fourth month of summer, on xinwei day, thieves entered the Imperial Ancestral Temple and stole Emperor Wuzong's golden spirit tablet and sacrificial vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month of summer, on xinwei day, thieves entered the Imperial Ancestral Temple and stole Emperor Wuzong's golden spirit tablet and sacrificial vessels.

sentences.zh: 大理鹿甸酋阿你為寇。

translations.literal: Chief Ani of Ludian in Dali raided.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Ani of Ludian in Dali raided.

sentences.zh: 壬甲，作武宗主。

translations.literal: On renshen day Emperor Wuzong's spirit tablet was made.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Emperor Wuzong's spirit tablet was made.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，作棕毛鹿頂樓。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day the Palm-Fiber Deer-Antler Topped Tower was built.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the Palm-Fiber Deer-Antler Topped Tower was built.

sentences.zh: 己卯，道州永明縣徭為寇。

translations.literal: On jimao day the Yao of Yongming County, Daozhou, raided.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day the Yao of Yongming County, Daozhou, raided.

sentences.zh: 癸未，鹽官州海水溢，侵地十九里，命都水少監張仲仁及行省官發工匠二萬餘人，以竹落木柵實石塞之，不止。

translations.literal: On guiwei day the sea at Yan'guan Prefecture overflowed, encroaching nineteen li of land; Supervising Commissioner of Waterworks Zhang Zhongren and provincial officials were ordered to mobilize over twenty thousand craftsmen to block it with bamboo cages, wooden palisades, and packed stones; it did not stop.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day the sea at Yan'guan Prefecture overflowed, encroaching 19 li of land; Supervising Commissioner of Waterworks Zhang Zhongren and provincial officials were ordered to mobilize over 20,000 craftsmen to block it with bamboo cages, wooden palisades, and packed stones; it did not stop.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，高州徭寇電白縣，千戶張恒力戰，死之，邑人立祠，敕賜額曰「旌義」。

translations.literal: On guisi day the Yao of Gaozhou raided Dianbai County; qianhu Zhang Heng fought fiercely and died; the townspeople erected a shrine, and an edict granted the plaque inscription "Commending Righteousness."
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the Yao of Gaozhou raided Dianbai County; qianhu Zhang Heng fought fiercely and died; the townspeople erected a shrine, and an edict granted the plaque inscription "Commending Righteousness."

sentences.zh: 甲午，以西僧公哥列思巴沖納思監藏班藏卜為帝師，賜玉印，仍詔諭天下僧。

translations.literal: On jiawu day the Western monk Gonggrelba Chongnasi Jianzang Banzangbu was made Imperial Preceptor, granted a jade seal, and an edict was also issued instructing all monks under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the Western monk Gonggrelba Chongnasi Jianzang Banzangbu was made Imperial Preceptor, granted a jade seal, and an edict was also issued instructing all monks under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以武備寺卿阿昔兒答剌罕為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On yiwei day the Director of the Armory Directorate Ashi'er Dalahan was appointed Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day the Director of the Armory Directorate Ashi'er Dalahan was appointed Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 翙星於回回司天臺。

translations.literal: A comet appeared at the Muslim Astronomy Observatory.
translations.idiomatic: A comet appeared at the Muslim Astronomy Observatory.

sentences.zh: 湖廣徭寇全州、義寧屬縣，命守將捕之。

translations.literal: The Yao of Huguang raided Quanzhou and dependent counties of Yining; garrison commanders were ordered to capture them.
translations.idiomatic: The Yao of Huguang raided Quanzhou and dependent counties of Yining; garrison commanders were ordered to capture them.

sentences.zh: 河南、奉元二路及通、順、檀、薊等州，漁陽、寶坻、香河等縣饑，賜糧兩月。

translations.literal: The two routes Henan and Fengyuan, prefectures including Tong, Shun, Tan, and Ji, and counties including Yuyang, Baodi, and Xianghe suffered famine; two months' grain was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The two routes Henan and Fengyuan, prefectures including Tong, Shun, Tan, and Ji, and counties including Yuyang, Baodi, and Xianghe suffered famine; 2 months' grain was granted.

sentences.zh: 河間、揚州、建康、太平、衢州、常州諸路屬縣及雲南烏撒、武定二路饑，賜糧、鈔有差。

translations.literal: Dependent counties of routes Hejian, Yangzhou, Jianning, Taiping, Quzhou, and Changzhou, and the two routes Wusa and Wuding in Yunnan suffered famine; relief grain and notes were granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Dependent counties of routes Hejian, Yangzhou, Jianning, Taiping, Quzhou, and Changzhou, and the two routes Wusa and Wuding in Yunnan suffered famine; relief grain and notes were granted in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 永平路饑，免其租，仍賑糧兩月。

translations.literal: Yongping Route suffered famine; its rent was remitted and two months' relief grain was still granted.
translations.idiomatic: Yongping Route suffered famine; its rent was remitted and 2 months' relief grain was still granted.

sentences.zh: 五月辛丑，太尉醜驢卒。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on xinchou day, Grand Commandant Choulu died.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, on xinchou day, Grand Commandant Choulu died.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以鹽官州海溢，命天師張嗣成修醮禳之。

translations.literal: On guimao day, because the sea at Yan'guan Prefecture overflowed, Celestial Master Zhang Sicheng was ordered to perform Daoist rites of supplication.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, because the sea at Yan'guan Prefecture overflowed, Celestial Master Zhang Sicheng was ordered to perform Daoist rites of supplication.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，作成宗神御殿於天壽萬寧寺。

translations.literal: On yisi day the Spirit Hall of Emperor Chengzong was completed at the Tianshou Wanning Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the Spirit Hall of Emperor Chengzong was completed at the Tianshou Wanning Temple.

sentences.zh: 己未，占城國遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On jiwei day Champa dispatched envoys presenting tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Champa dispatched envoys presenting tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以典守宗廟不嚴，罷太常禮儀院官。

translations.literal: On jiazi day, because guardianship of the Imperial Ancestral Temple was not strict, officials of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, because guardianship of the Imperial Ancestral Temple was not strict, officials of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，修佛事於賀蘭山及諸行宮。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Buddhist rites were performed at Helan Mountain and various imperial traveling palaces.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Buddhist rites were performed at Helan Mountain and various imperial traveling palaces.

sentences.zh: 罷諸王分地州縣長官世襲，俾如常調官，以三載為考。

translations.literal: The hereditary succession of prefecture and county chiefs in princes' fief territories was abolished; they were made like regularly assigned officials, with three years as the term of evaluation.
translations.idiomatic: The hereditary succession of prefecture and county chiefs in princes' fief territories was abolished; they were made like regularly assigned officials, with 3 years as the term of evaluation.

sentences.zh: 元江路總管普雙坐贓免，遂結蠻兵作亂，敕復其舊職。

translations.literal: Route commander Pushuang of Yuanjiang Route was dismissed for corruption; he then rallied tribal troops and rebelled; an edict restored him to his former office.
translations.idiomatic: Route commander Pushuang of Yuanjiang Route was dismissed for corruption; he then rallied tribal troops and rebelled; an edict restored him to his former office.

sentences.zh: 德慶路徭來降，歸所掠男女，悉給其親。

translations.literal: The Yao of Deqing Route submitted; men and women they had seized were returned, all being given back to their relatives.
translations.idiomatic: The Yao of Deqing Route submitted; men and women they had seized were returned, all being given back to their relatives.

sentences.zh: 河南、江陵屬縣饑，賑糧有差。

translations.literal: Dependent counties of Henan and Jiangling suffered famine; relief grain was granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Dependent counties of Henan and Jiangling suffered famine; relief grain was granted in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 汴梁屬縣饑，免其租。

translations.literal: Dependent counties of Bianliang suffered famine; their rent was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Dependent counties of Bianliang suffered famine; their rent was remitted.

sentences.zh: 常州、淮安二路，寧海州大雨雹，睢州河溢，大都、南陽、汝寧、廬州等路屬縣旱蝗，衛輝路大風九日，木盡偃。

translations.literal: The two routes Changzhou and Huai'an, Ninghai Prefecture suffered heavy hail; the river at Suizhou overflowed; dependent counties of routes Dadu, Nanyang, Runing, and Luzhou suffered drought and locusts; Weihui Route had great wind for nine days and trees were all uprooted.
translations.idiomatic: The two routes Changzhou and Huai'an, Ninghai Prefecture suffered heavy hail; the river at Suizhou overflowed; dependent counties of routes Dadu, Nanyang, Runing, and Luzhou suffered drought and locusts; Weihui Route had great wind for 9 days and trees were all uprooted.

sentences.zh: 河南路洛陽縣有蝗可五畝，群烏食之既，數日蝗再集，又食之。

translations.literal: In Luoyang County of Henan Route there were locusts covering about five mu; after flocks of crows ate them, within several days the locusts gathered again and were eaten again.
translations.idiomatic: In Luoyang County of Henan Route there were locusts covering about 5 mu; after flocks of crows ate them, within several days the locusts gathered again and were eaten again.

sentences.zh: 六月辛未，翰林侍講學士阿魯威、直學士燕赤等進講，仍命譯《資治通鑒》以進。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on xinwei day, Hanlin Lecturer-in-Waiting Aruwei, Associate Academician Yanchi, and others lectured; they were also ordered to translate the Comprehensive Mirror for Aid in Government and submit it.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, on xinwei day, Hanlin Lecturer-in-Waiting Aruwei, Associate Academician Yanchi, and others lectured; they were also ordered to translate the Comprehensive Mirror for Aid in Government and submit it.

sentences.zh: 參知政事史惟良請解職歸養，不允。

translations.literal: Vice Grand Councillor Shi Weiliang requested to resign and return home to care for his parents; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Grand Councillor Shi Weiliang requested to resign and return home to care for his parents; it was not granted.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，倒剌沙等以災變乞罷，不允。

translations.literal: On dingchou day Dowlatash and others requested dismissal on account of calamities and omens; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Dowlatash and others requested dismissal on account of calamities and omens; it was not granted.

sentences.zh: 罷兩都營繕工役，錄諸郡系囚。

translations.literal: Construction corvée at the two capitals was halted; prisoners held in various prefectures were recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Construction corvée at the two capitals was halted; prisoners held in various prefectures were recorded.

sentences.zh: 己卯，永興屯被災，免其租。

translations.literal: On jimao day Yongxing Garrison Farm suffered disaster; its rent was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Yongxing Garrison Farm suffered disaster; its rent was remitted.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，造象輿六乘。

translations.literal: On xinsi day six elephant palanquins were made.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day 6 elephant palanquins were made.

sentences.zh: 癸未，遣察乃、伯顏赴大都銓選。

translations.literal: On guiwei day Chana and Bayan were dispatched to Dadu for appointment selection.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Chana and Bayan were dispatched to Dadu for appointment selection.

sentences.zh: 甲申，廣西花角蠻為寇，命所部討之。

translations.literal: On jiashen day the Hua-jiao tribes of Guangxi raided; local forces were ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the Hua-jiao tribes of Guangxi raided; local forces were ordered to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 乙未，紹慶路四洞酋阿者等降，並命為蠻夷長官，仍設巡檢司以撫之。

translations.literal: On yiwei day chiefs Aze and others of the Four Caves of Shaoqing Route submitted; all were appointed tribal chiefs, and inspection offices were also established to pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day chiefs Aze and others of the Four Caves of Shaoqing Route submitted; all were appointed tribal chiefs, and inspection offices were also established to pacify them.

sentences.zh: 發義倉粟，賑鹽官州民。

translations.literal: Charity-granary grain was issued to relieve the people of Yan'guan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Charity-granary grain was issued to relieve the people of Yan'guan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 廬州路饑，賑糧七萬九千石。

translations.literal: Luzhou Route suffered famine; seventy-nine thousand shi of relief grain was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Luzhou Route suffered famine; 79,000 shi of relief grain was granted.

sentences.zh: 鎮江、興國二路饑，賑糶有差。

translations.literal: The two routes Zhenjiang and Xingguo suffered famine; relief grain for sale was granted in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: The two routes Zhenjiang and Xingguo suffered famine; relief grain for sale was granted in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 中山府雨雹，汴梁路河決，汝寧府旱，大都、河間、濟南、大名、峽州屬縣蝗。

translations.literal: Zhongshan Prefecture suffered hail; the river at Bianliang Route burst its banks; Runing Prefecture suffered drought; dependent counties of Dadu, Hejian, Jinan, Daming, and Xiazhou suffered locusts.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongshan Prefecture suffered hail; the river at Bianliang Route burst its banks; Runing Prefecture suffered drought; dependent counties of Dadu, Hejian, Jinan, Daming, and Xiazhou suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁酉，元江路普雙復叛。

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, on dingyou day, Pushuang of Yuanjiang Route rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month of autumn, on dingyou day, Pushuang of Yuanjiang Route rebelled again.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，諸王燕只吉臺襲位，遣使來朝。

translations.literal: On wuxu day Prince Yanzhi Jitai succeeded to his title and dispatched envoys to court.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Prince Yanzhi Jitai succeeded to his title and dispatched envoys to court.

sentences.zh: 己亥，八兒忽部晃忽來獻方物。

translations.literal: On jihai day Huanghu of the Ba'erhu tribe presented tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Huanghu of the Ba'erhu tribe presented tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 御史臺臣言，內郡、江南，旱、蝗薦至，非國細故，丞相塔失帖木兒、倒剌沙，參知政事不花、史惟良，參議買奴，並乞解職。

translations.literal: Censorate officials said: "In the inner prefectures and Jiangnan drought and locusts occur one after another — this is no minor matter of state; Grand Councillor Tash Temür, Dowlatash, Vice Grand Councillors Buhua and Shi Weiliang, and Administrative Assistant Mainu all request resignation."
translations.idiomatic: Censorate officials said, "In the inner prefectures and Jiangnan drought and locusts occur one after another — this is no minor matter of state; Grand Councillor Tash Temür, Dowlatash, Vice Grand Councillors Buhua and Shi Weiliang, and Administrative Assistant Mainu all request resignation."

sentences.zh: 有旨：「毋多辭，朕當自儆，卿等亦宜各欽厥職。

translations.literal: An imperial directive stated: "Do not decline excessively; I shall examine myself, and you too should each reverently perform your duties.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial directive stated, "Do not decline excessively; I shall examine myself, and you too should each reverently perform your duties.

sentences.zh: 」修大明殿。

translations.literal: " The Daming Hall was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: The Daming Hall was repaired.

sentences.zh: 占城國獻馴象二。

translations.idiomatic: Prince of Liaoning Tuotuo was granted 5,000 ingots of notes; Prince of Liang Wang Shan was granted 2,000 ingots of notes.

translations.literal: On renxu day Venus appeared in the daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Venus appeared in the daytime.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，解州鹽池黑龍堰壞，調番休鹽丁修之。

translations.literal: On guihai day the Heilong Dam of Jie Prefecture's salt ponds was damaged; Fanxiu salt laborers were mobilized to repair it.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the Heilong Dam of Jie Prefecture's salt ponds was damaged; Fanxiu salt laborers were mobilized to repair it.

sentences.zh: 陜西諸路饑，賑鈔五萬錠。

translations.literal: Shaanxi's various routes suffered famine; fifty thousand ingots of notes were granted in relief.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi's various routes suffered famine; 50,000 ingots of notes were granted in relief.

sentences.zh: 河間、汴梁二路屬縣及開城、乾州蒙古軍饑，並賑之。

translations.literal: Dependent counties of Hejian and Bianliang routes and the Mongol troops at Kaicheng and Qian Prefecture suffered famine; all were granted relief.
translations.idiomatic: Dependent counties of Hejian and Bianliang routes and the Mongol troops at Kaicheng and Qian Prefecture suffered famine; all were granted relief.

sentences.zh: 三月庚午，阿速衛兵出戍者千人，人給鈔四十錠；

translations.literal: Third month, on gengwu day, one thousand Asud Guard soldiers on frontier garrison duty were each granted forty ingots of notes;
translations.idiomatic: Third month, on gengwu day, 1,000 Asud Guard soldiers on frontier garrison duty were each granted 40 ingots of notes;

sentences.zh: 貧乏者六千一百人，人給米五石。

translations.literal: Six thousand one hundred impoverished persons were each granted five shi of grain.
translations.idiomatic: 6,100 impoverished persons were each granted 5 shi of grain.

sentences.zh: 雲南安隆寨土官岑世忠與其兄世興相攻，籍其民三萬二千戶來附，歲輸布三千匹，請立宣撫司以總之，不允。

translations.literal: Anlong Stockade native official Cen Shizhong of Yunnan and his elder brother Shixing attacked each other; he registered thirty-two thousand households and submitted, offering three thousand bolts of cloth annually; he requested establishment of a pacification commission to oversee the area — not approved.
translations.idiomatic: Anlong Stockade native official Cen Shizhong of Yunnan and his elder brother Shixing attacked each other; he registered 32,000 households and submitted, offering 3,000 bolts of cloth annually; he requested establishment of a pacification commission to oversee the area — not approved.

sentences.zh: 置州一，以世興知州事，置縣二，聽世忠舉人用之，仍諭其兄弟共處。

translations.literal: One prefecture was established, with Shixing in charge of prefectural affairs; two counties were established, with Shizhong allowed to recommend appointees; they were also instructed to live together in harmony.
translations.idiomatic: One prefecture was established, with Shixing in charge of prefectural affairs; 2 counties were established, with Shizhong allowed to recommend appointees; they were also instructed to live together in harmony.

sentences.zh: 立萬戶府二，領征西紅胖襖軍。

translations.literal: Two wanhu offices were established, commanding the Western Campaign Red Padded-Jacket Army.
translations.idiomatic: Two wanhu offices were established, commanding the Western Campaign Red Padded-Jacket Army.

sentences.zh: 塔失帖木兒、倒剌沙言：「災異未弭，由官吏以罪黜罷者怨誹所致，請量才敘用。

translations.literal: Tash Temür and Dilqash said, "Calamities and portents have not ceased, due to dismissed officials who were removed for crimes bearing resentment and slander; we request they be appointed according to talent and ability.
translations.idiomatic: Tash Temür and Dilqash said, "Calamities and portents have not ceased, due to dismissed officials who were removed for crimes bearing resentment and slander; we request they be appointed according to talent and ability.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 辛未，大天源延聖寺顯宗神御殿成，置總管府以司財賦。

translations.literal: On xinwei day the spirit hall of Emperor Xianzong at the Great Tianyuan Yansheng Temple was completed; a commissioner office was established to manage revenues.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the spirit hall of Emperor Xianzong at the Great Tianyuan Yansheng Temple was completed; a commissioner office was established to manage revenues.

sentences.zh: 壬申，雨霾。

translations.literal: On renshen day there was rain and haze.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day there was rain and haze.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，雅濟國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day the country of Yaji dispatched envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the country of Yaji dispatched envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，帝御興聖殿受無量壽佛戒於帝師。

translations.literal: On yimao day the Emperor attended Xingsheng Hall to receive the Amitayus Buddha precepts from the Imperial Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the Emperor attended Xingsheng Hall to receive the Amitayus Buddha precepts from the Imperial Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命僧千人修佛事於鎮國寺。

translations.literal: On gengchen day one thousand monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites at Zhenguo Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day 1,000 monks were ordered to perform Buddhist rites at Zhenguo Temple.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，賜壽寧公主鹽價鈔萬引。

translations.literal: On xinsi day Princess Shouning was granted ten thousand strings of notes for salt prices.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Princess Shouning was granted 10,000 strings of notes for salt prices.

sentences.zh: 甲申，遣戶部尚書李家奴往鹽官祀海神，仍集議修海岸。

translations.literal: On jiashen day Minister of Revenue Li Jianu was dispatched to Yanguan to sacrifice to the Sea God, and also to assemble deliberation on repairing the coast.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Minister of Revenue Li Jianu was dispatched to Yanguan to sacrifice to the Sea God, and also to assemble deliberation on repairing the coast.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔帝師命僧修佛事於鹽官州，仍造浮屠二百一十六，以厭海溢。

translations.literal: On bingxu day an edict directed the Imperial Preceptor to order monks to perform Buddhist rites at Yanguan Prefecture, and also to build two hundred sixteen pagodas to suppress seawater overflow.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day an edict directed the Imperial Preceptor to order monks to perform Buddhist rites at Yanguan Prefecture, and also to build 216 pagodas to suppress seawater overflow.

sentences.zh: 戊子，車駕幸上都。

translations.literal: On wuzi day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以趙世延知經筵事，趙簡預經筵事，阿魯威同知經筵事，曹元用、吳秉道、虞集、段輔、馬祖常、燕赤、孛術魯翀並兼經筵官。

translations.literal: On jichou day Zhao Shiyan was made superintendent of the Classics Colloquium; Zhao Jian was made associate superintendent; Aruwei was made deputy superintendent; Cao Yuanyong, Wu Bingdao, Yu Ji, Duan Fu, Ma Zuchang, Yanchi, and Bolu Chung were all additionally appointed Classics Colloquium officials.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Zhao Shiyan was made superintendent of the Classics Colloquium; Zhao Jian was made associate superintendent; Aruwei was made deputy superintendent; Cao Yuanyong, Wu Bingdao, Yu Ji, Duan Fu, Ma Zuchang, Yanchi, and Bolu Chung were all additionally appointed Classics Colloquium officials.

sentences.zh: 雲南土官撒加布降，奉方物來獻，置州一，以撒加布知州事，隸羅羅宣慰司，征其租賦。

translations.literal: Yunnan native official Sajiabu submitted, presenting local products; one prefecture was established, with Sajiabu in charge of prefectural affairs, subordinate to the Luoluo Pacification Commission, and his rent and levies were collected.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan native official Sajiabu submitted, presenting local products; one prefecture was established, with Sajiabu in charge of prefectural affairs, subordinate to the Luoluo Pacification Commission, and his rent and levies were collected.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，太平路當塗縣楊氏婦一產三子。

translations.literal: On renchen day a woman of the Yang clan in Dangtu County, Taiping Route, gave birth to triplets.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day a woman of the Yang clan in Dangtu County, Taiping Route, gave birth to triplets.

sentences.zh: 晉寧、衛輝二路及泰安州饑，賑鈔四萬八千三百錠。

translations.literal: Jining and Weihui routes and Tai'an Prefecture suffered famine; forty-eight thousand three hundred ingots of notes were granted in relief.
translations.idiomatic: Jining and Weihui routes and Tai'an Prefecture suffered famine; 48,300 ingots of notes were granted in relief.

sentences.zh: 冀寧路平定州饑，賑糶米三萬石。

translations.literal: Pingding Prefecture of Jining Route suffered famine; thirty thousand shi of grain was issued and sold at reduced prices.
translations.idiomatic: Pingding Prefecture of Jining Route suffered famine; 30,000 shi of grain was issued and sold at reduced prices.

sentences.zh: 陜西、四川及河南府等處饑，並賑之。

translations.literal: Shaanxi, Sichuan, and Henan Prefecture and other places suffered famine; all were granted relief.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi, Sichuan, and Henan Prefecture and other places suffered famine; all were granted relief.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙申，欽州徭黃焱等為寇，命湖廣行省備之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on bingshen day, Qin Prefecture Yao Huang Yan and others raided as bandits; the Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to prepare against them.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on bingshen day, Qin Prefecture Yao Huang Yan and others raided as bandits; the Huguang Branch Secretariat was ordered to prepare against them.

sentences.zh: 己亥，塔失帖木兒、倒剌沙請凡蒙古、色目人效漢法丁憂者除其名，從之。

translations.literal: On jihai day Tash Temür and Dilqash requested that wherever Mongols and semu persons observed Han-style mourning for a parent, their names be removed from office — approved.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Tash Temür and Dilqash requested that wherever Mongols and semu persons observed Han-style mourning for a parent, their names be removed from office — approved.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，李家奴以作石囤捍海議聞。

translations.literal: On renyin day Li Jianu reported the proposal for building stone cribs to hold back the sea.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Li Jianu reported the proposal for building stone cribs to hold back the sea.

sentences.zh: 己酉，御史楊倬等以民饑，請分僧道儲粟濟之，不報。

translations.literal: On jiyou day surveillance censor Yang Zhuo and others, citing famine among the people, requested distributing stored grain from monks and Daoists to relieve them — no response.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day surveillance censor Yang Zhuo and others, citing famine among the people, requested distributing stored grain from monks and Daoists to relieve them — no response.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，改封蒙山神曰嘉惠昭應王，鹽池神曰靈富公，洞庭廟神曰忠惠順利靈濟昭佑王，唐柳州刺史柳宗元曰文惠昭靈公。

translations.literal: On jiayin day Mount Meng Spirit was re-enfeoffed as King Jiahui Zhaoying; Salt Pond Spirit as Duke Lingfu; Dongting Shrine Spirit as King Zhonghui Shunli Lingji Zhaoyou; Tang Liuzhou prefect Liu Zongyuan as Duke Wenhui Zhaoling.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Mount Meng Spirit was re-enfeoffed as King Jiahui Zhaoying; Salt Pond Spirit as Duke Lingfu; Dongting Shrine Spirit as King Zhonghui Shunli Lingji Zhaoyou; Tang Liuzhou prefect Liu Zongyuan as Duke Wenhui Zhaoling.

sentences.zh: 戊午，禁偽造金銀器皿。

translations.literal: On wuwu day counterfeiting gold and silver vessels was prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day counterfeiting gold and silver vessels was prohibited.

sentences.zh: 大都、東昌、大寧、汴梁、懷慶之屬州縣饑，發粟賑之。

translations.literal: Dependent prefectures and counties of Dadu, Dongchang, Daning, Bianliang, and Huaqing suffered famine; grain was issued in relief.
translations.idiomatic: Dependent prefectures and counties of Dadu, Dongchang, Daning, Bianliang, and Huaqing suffered famine; grain was issued in relief.

sentences.zh: 保定、冠州、德州、般陽、彰德、濟南屬州縣饑，發鈔賑之。

translations.literal: Dependent prefectures and counties of Baoding, Guanzhou, Dezhou, Panyang, Zhangde, and Jinan suffered famine; notes were issued in relief.
translations.idiomatic: Dependent prefectures and counties of Baoding, Guanzhou, Dezhou, Panyang, Zhangde, and Jinan suffered famine; notes were issued in relief.

sentences.zh: 是月，靈州、浚州大雨雹。

translations.literal: That month, Lingzhou and Jun Prefecture had heavy hail.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Lingzhou and Jun Prefecture had heavy hail.

sentences.zh: 薊州及岐山、石城二縣蝗。

translations.literal: Jizhou and Qishan and Shicheng counties had locusts.
translations.idiomatic: Jizhou and Qishan and Shicheng counties had locusts.

sentences.zh: 廣寧路大水，崇明州大風，海溢。

translations.literal: Guangning Route suffered great flooding; Chongming Prefecture had strong wind and seawater overflow.
translations.idiomatic: Guangning Route suffered great flooding; Chongming Prefecture had strong wind and seawater overflow.

sentences.zh: 五月甲子，遣官分護流民還鄉，仍禁聚至千人者杖一百。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on jiazi day, officials were dispatched separately to escort displaced persons back to their home districts; gathering in groups of up to a thousand persons was still prohibited, with one hundred blows of the staff as punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, on jiazi day, officials were dispatched separately to escort displaced persons back to their home districts; gathering in groups of up to 1,000 persons was still prohibited, with 100 blows of the staff as punishment.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，廣西普寧縣僧陳慶安作亂，僭建國，改元。

translations.literal: On bingyin day the monk Chen Qing'an of Puning County, Guangxi, rebelled, presumptuously establishing a state and changing the era name.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the monk Chen Qing'an of Puning County, Guangxi, rebelled, presumptuously establishing a state and changing the era name.

sentences.zh: 己巳，八百媳婦蠻遣子哀招獻馴象。

translations.literal: On jisi day Babai Xifuman dispatched his son Aizhao presenting a tame elephant.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Babai Xifuman dispatched his son Aizhao presenting a tame elephant.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，籍在京流民廢疾者，給糧遣還。

translations.literal: On guiyou day disabled persons among displaced persons in the capital were registered, granted grain, and sent back.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day disabled persons among displaced persons in the capital were registered, granted grain, and sent back.

sentences.zh: 大理怒江甸土官阿哀你寇樂辰諸寨，命雲南行省督兵捕之。

translations.literal: Dali Nujiang Prefecture native official A'aini raided Lezhu and other stockades; the Yunnan Branch Secretariat was ordered to supervise troops in capturing him.
translations.idiomatic: Dali Nujiang Prefecture native official A'aini raided Lezhu and other stockades; the Yunnan Branch Secretariat was ordered to supervise troops in capturing him.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，有流星大如缶，其光燭地。

translations.literal: On gengchen day a meteor as large as a jar appeared, its light illuminating the ground.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day a meteor as large as a jar appeared, its light illuminating the ground.

sentences.zh: 甲申，安南國及八洞蠻酋遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On jiashen day the kingdom of Annam and chieftains of the Eight-Cave tribes dispatched envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the kingdom of Annam and chieftains of the Eight-Cave tribes dispatched envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以嶺北行省平章政事塔失帖木兒為中書平章政事。

translations.literal: On wuzi day Tash Temür, grand councillor of the Lingbei Branch Secretariat, was made central secretariat grand councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Tash Temür, grand councillor of the Lingbei Branch Secretariat, was made central secretariat grand councillor.

sentences.zh: 是月，燕南、山東東道及奉元、大同、河間、河南、東平、濮州等處饑，賑鈔十四萬三千餘錠。

translations.literal: That month, Yanshan South, Shandong East Circuit, and Fengyuan, Datong, Hejian, Henan, Dongping, Puzhou and other places suffered famine; more than one hundred forty-three thousand ingots of notes were granted in relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Yanshan South, Shandong East Circuit, and Fengyuan, Datong, Hejian, Henan, Dongping, Puzhou and other places suffered famine; more than 143,000 ingots of notes were granted in relief.

sentences.zh: 峽州屬縣饑，賑糶糧五千石。

translations.literal: Dependent counties of Xia Prefecture suffered famine; five thousand shi of grain was issued and sold at reduced prices in relief.
translations.idiomatic: Dependent counties of Xia Prefecture suffered famine; 5,000 shi of grain was issued and sold at reduced prices in relief.

sentences.zh: 冀寧、廣平、真定諸路屬縣大雨雹，汝寧府潁州、衛輝路汲縣蝗，涇州靈臺縣旱。

translations.literal: Dependent counties of Jining, Guangping, and Zhending routes had heavy hail; Yingzhou of Runing Prefecture and Jixian of Weihui Route had locusts; Lingtai County of Jing Prefecture suffered drought.
translations.idiomatic: Dependent counties of Jining, Guangping, and Zhending routes had heavy hail; Yingzhou of Runing Prefecture and Jixian of Weihui Route had locusts; Lingtai County of Jing Prefecture suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 六月，高麗世子完者禿訴取其印，遣平章政事買閭往諭高麗王，俾還之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, the Korean crown prince Wangzhetu petitioned for the return of his seal; grand councillor Mailü was dispatched to instruct the king of Goryeo to return it.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, the Korean crown prince Wangzhetu petitioned for the return of his seal; grand councillor Mailü was dispatched to instruct the king of Goryeo to return it.

sentences.zh: 丙午，遣使祀世祖神御殿。

translations.literal: On bingwu day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at Emperor Shizu's spirit hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at Emperor Shizu's spirit hall.

sentences.zh: 是月，諸王喃答失、徹徹禿、火沙、乃馬臺諸郡風雪斃畜牧，士卒饑，賑糧五萬石、鈔四十萬錠。

translations.literal: That month, in the various commanderies of Princes Nandash, Cheche Tu, Huosha, and Naimatai wind and snow killed livestock; soldiers suffered famine; fifty thousand shi of grain and four hundred thousand ingots of notes were granted in relief.
translations.idiomatic: That month, in the various commanderies of Princes Nandash, Cheche Tu, Huosha, and Naimatai wind and snow killed livestock; soldiers suffered famine; 50,000 shi of grain and 400,000 ingots of notes were granted in relief.

sentences.zh: 奉元、延安二路饑，賑鈔四千八百九十錠。

translations.literal: Fengyuan and Yan'an routes suffered famine; four thousand eight hundred ninety ingots of notes were granted in relief.
translations.idiomatic: Fengyuan and Yan'an routes suffered famine; 4,890 ingots of notes were granted in relief.

sentences.zh: 彰德屬縣大雨雹，南寧、開元、永平諸路水，江陵路屬縣旱，河南德安屯蠖食桑。

translations.literal: Zhangde dependent counties had heavy hail; Nanning, Kaiyuan, and Yongping routes had flooding; dependent counties of Jiangling Route suffered drought; De'an garrison-farm in Henan had silk worms eating mulberry leaves.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangde dependent counties had heavy hail; Nanning, Kaiyuan, and Yongping routes had flooding; dependent counties of Jiangling Route suffered drought; De'an garrison-farm in Henan had silk worms eating mulberry leaves.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉朔，寧夏地震。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on xinyou new moon, Ningxia suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on xinyou new moon, Ningxia suffered an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 庚午，帝崩，壽三十六，葬起輦谷。

translations.literal: On gengwu day the Emperor died; he was thirty-six years old and was buried at Qinian Valley.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Emperor died; he was 36 years old and was buried at Qinian Valley.

sentences.zh: 己卯，大寧路地震。

translations.literal: On jimao day Daning Route suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Daning Route suffered an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 癸未，修佛事於欽明殿。

translations.literal: On guiwei day Buddhist rites were performed at Qinming Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Buddhist rites were performed at Qinming Hall.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，皇后、皇太子降旨諭安百姓。

translations.literal: On yiyou day the empress and crown prince issued directives reassuring and settling the common people.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the empress and crown prince issued directives reassuring and settling the common people.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，太白犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: On bingxu day Venus transgressed the great star of Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Venus transgressed the great star of Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 九月，倒剌沙立皇太子為皇帝，改元天順，詔天下。

translations.literal: Ninth month, Dilqash installed the crown prince as emperor, changed the era name to Tianshun, and proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, Dilqash installed the crown prince as emperor, changed the era name to Tianshun, and proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 泰定之世，災異數見，君臣之間，亦未見其引咎責躬之實，然能知守祖宗之法以行，天下無事，號稱治平，茲其所以為足稱也。

translations.literal: In the Taiding era calamities and portents appeared repeatedly; among ruler and ministers likewise no actual practice of accepting blame and examining oneself was seen — yet they knew how to adhere to ancestral laws in carrying out affairs; under Heaven there was no turmoil, and the age was called well governed — this is why it deserves to be regarded as sufficient grounds for praise.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taiding era calamities and portents appeared repeatedly; among ruler and ministers likewise no actual practice of accepting blame and examining oneself was seen — yet they knew how to adhere to ancestral laws in carrying out affairs; under Heaven there was no turmoil, and the age was called well governed — this is why it deserves to be regarded as sufficient grounds for praise.
